news.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
news.summary: Shares of cybersecurity platform provider Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ:PANW) jumped 12% in the afternoon session after peer cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike reported stronger-than-expected quarterly financial results, lifting investor sentiment across the cybersecurity sector.

news.title: CrowdStrike (CRWD) Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
news.summary: Shares of cybersecurity platform provider CrowdStrike (NASDAQ:CRWD) jumped 17.9% in the afternoon session after the company reported second-quarter financial results that topped Wall Street expectations and raised its full-year outlook.

news.title: CRWD Q2 Deep Dive: AI Security Demand Drives Growth and Platform Consolidation
news.summary: Cybersecurity platform provider CrowdStrike (NASDAQ:CRWD) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 25.8% year on year to $1.47 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $1.53 billion at the midpoint, 0.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.31 per share was 6.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

news.title: Tech investors are looking at AI with 'more nuance' as it fuels software demand
news.summary: Salesforce stock (CRM) surges ahead by over 22% on Thursday since releasing strong second quarter earnings results, coming at a time when AI demand is driving growth within the software sector. Macquarie US head of software and services research Steve Koenig examines what he is seeing from tech investors and how Salesforce performed.
